arXiv:2605.23872v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 5 月 22 日arXiv:2605.23872v1 [cs.LG] 22 May 2026

免培训环形变压器Training-Free Looped Transformers

Lizhang Chen &Jonathan Li11footnotemark: 1 &Chen Liang &Ni Lao &Qiang Liu Equal contribution
摘要Abstract

我们介绍We introduce免培训环形变压器training-free looped transformers，其中轻量级推理时间包装器循环冻结检查点的连续中间堆栈块，无需额外的微调、持续训练或架构更改。与之前使用循环结构端到端训练的循环变压器方法不同，我们在测试时将递归改进到预训练模型上。我们表明，简单的块重新应用通常会降低性能，这凸显了循环应用策略的重要性。动机是, in which a lightweight inference-time wrapper loops a contiguous mid-stack block of layers of a frozen checkpoint without additional fine-tuning, continued training, or architectural changes. Unlike prior looped transformer methods that train with the looped structure end-to-end, we retrofit recurrence onto pretrained models at test time. We show that naive block reapplication usually degrades performance, highlighting the importance of the loop application strategy. Motivated by将预范数变换器块视为 ODE 上的前向欧拉步骤viewing a pre-norm transformer block as a forward Euler step on an ODE，我们将循环视为同一近似值的细化，用较小的阻尼子步骤替换一个较大的更新。在七个密集、稀疏 MoE 和 MLA+MoE 模型系列中，我们的方法在 MMLU-Pro 上将 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 提高了 +2.64 pp，在 CommonsenseQA 上将 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct 提高了 +1.14 pp，在 OpenBookQA 上将 Moonlight-16B-A3B-Instruct 提高了 +1.20 pp。, we instead treat looping as a refinement of the same approximation, replacing one large update with smaller damped sub-steps. Across seven dense, sparse MoE, and MLA+MoE model families, our method improves Qwen3-4B-Instruct by +2.64 pp on MMLU-Pro, Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct by +1.14 pp on CommonsenseQA, and Moonlight-16B-A3B-Instruct by +1.20 pp on OpenBookQA.

1 简介Introduction

环形变压器Looped transformers (Giannou et al., 2023; Fan et al., 2025), 通用变形金刚, Universal Transformers(Dehghani et al., 2019; Lan et al., 2020)，和深度均衡模型, and Deep Equilibrium models(Bai et al., 2019, 2020)全部合并all incorporate复发recurrence进入架构into the architecture(Xu and Sato, 2025a; Saunshi et al., 2025; Merrill and Sabharwal, 2025; Gong et al., 2025)和重量and weights(Geiping et al., 2025a; Zhu et al., 2025; Prairie et al., 2026; Wu et al., 2025)。各层在循环迭代中相互联系并进行相应的优化，因此递归结构与训练参数密不可分。因此，循环不能应用于未使用此方法进行训练的模型，几乎所有公开发布的语言模型检查点都是如此。这自然就引出了本文的核心问题：. Layers are tied across loop iterations and optimized accordingly, so the recurrence structure is inseparable from the trained parameters. As a consequence, looping cannot be applied to a model that was not trained with this methodology in mind, which is the case for almost all publicly released language-model checkpoints. This naturally gives rise to the core question of this paper:

具体来说，现代开放式法学硕士，例如 Qwen3Concretely, modern open-weight LLMs, such as Qwen3(Team, 2025b), 骆驼-3.2, Llama-3.2(Team, 2024a), 月光, Moonlight(Liu et al., 2025)和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite(DeepSeek-AI, 2024)，是多阶段管道的端点，通常包括持续预训练、监督微调和一轮或多轮 RLHF/DPO 后训练, are the endpoints of a multi-stage pipeline that typically includes continued pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and one or more rounds of RLHF / DPO post-training(DeepSeek-AI, 2025)。我们采用模型作者发布的任何权重，并在推理时应用循环包装器，而不进行任何类型的进一步权重更新。. We take whatever weights the model authors release and apply the loop wrapper at inference, with no further weight updates of any kind.

几条汇聚的证据指向核心问题的积极答案。Several converging strands of evidence point towards a positive answer to core question.Men et al. (2025)表明可以以最小的损失删除已发布的变压器 LM 的整个中间层块；show that whole mid-layer blocks of released transformer LMs can be deleted with minimal loss;Lad et al. (2024)报告中间层可以被跳过、交换或重复，而不会发生灾难性的退化；和report that mid-layers can be skipped, swapped, or repeated without catastrophic degradation; andBelrose et al. (2023)证明中间层逻辑已经编码了大部分最终预测demonstrate that intermediate-layer logits already encode much of the final prediction(Takase and Kiyono, 2023; Reid et al., 2021)。对这些结果的普遍解释是. The prevailing interpretation of these results is one of压缩性compressibility——中间层是冗余的，所以我们可以删除它们——但这忽略了一个补充的观点：使中间层安全删除的相同冗余也使得可以安全地删除它们。—middle layers are redundant, so we can remove them—but this ignores a complementary perspective: the same redundancy that makes a mid-layer safe to delete makes it safe to重新申请re-apply。这种见解承认我们在第 1 节中开发的数值分析解释. This insight admits a numerical analysis interpretation that we develop in Section2.3：每个预范数变换器层恰好是一个前向欧拉步骤: each pre-norm transformer layer is exactly one forward Euler step ath=1h{=}1在每块残差 ODE 上，所以on a per-block residual ODE, so从几何角度来看，在推理时重新应用该块是网络已经近似的 ODE 的更精细积分re-applying the block at inference is, geometrically, a finer integration of the ODE the network already approximates (Bai et al., 2019, 2020)。特别是，. In particular,KK大小的子步骤sub-steps of sizeh=1/Kh{=}1/K最好近似相同better approximate the samet=1t{=}1未经修改的网络经过训练可以提供的端点。endpoint that the unmodified network was trained to deliver.

我们表明，这种几何动机可以转化为现代检查站的可衡量的收益We show that this geometric motivation translates into measurable gains on modern checkpoints across七个模范家庭seven model families——Qwen3—Qwen3(Team, 2025b)（0.6B/1.7B/4B 基础和指令、30B-A3B MoE）、Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B、Llama-3.2(0.6B/1.7B/4B base & instruct, 30B-A3B MoE), Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B, Llama-3.2(Team, 2024a)(1B/3B)、月光(1B/3B), Moonlight(Liu et al., 2025)和 DeepSeek-V2-Lite, and DeepSeek-V2-Lite(DeepSeek-AI, 2024)——并且—and45 个（模型、基准）单元45 (model, benchmark) cells免训练循环评估。循环评估在知识密集型多项选择基准测试中获得了最大的收益：在 MMLU-Pro 上 +2.64of training-free loop evaluation. Looped evaluation yields its strongest gains on knowledge-heavy multiple-choice benchmarks: +2.64 on MMLU-Pro(Wang et al., 2024)GPQA-Main 上+2.01and +2.01 on GPQA-Main(Rein et al., 2024)Qwen3-4B-Instruct，以及 ARC-Challenge +2.30for Qwen3-4B-Instruct, and +2.30 on ARC-Challenge(Clark et al., 2018)适用于 Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-聊天。实验使用了大约 20,000 NVIDIA H100 HBM3-80GB GPU 小时。for Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B-Chat. Approximately 20,000 NVIDIA H100 HBM3-80GB GPU hours were used for the experiments.

这些改进无需任何参数更新、额外的监督或特定于基准的调整即可实现，这表明现有变压器块的重复应用可以暴露潜在的推理时间计算。我们进一步将前向欧拉积分与高阶定点加速器和求解器进行比较，包括Anderson加速、重球加速、Aitken加速These improvements arise without any parameter updates, additional supervision, or benchmark-specific tuning, suggesting that repeated application of existing transformer blocks can expose latent inference-time computation. We further compare forward Euler integration with higher-order fixed-point accelerators and solvers, including Anderson acceleration, heavy-ball, Aitken acceleration(Walker and Ni, 2011)，以及龙格-库塔式更新。, and Runge–Kutta-style updates.

我们的主要贡献如下：Our main contributions are as follows:

  1. 1.

    无需训练的循环包装器A training-free loop wrapper，完全指定，具有块和层迭代模式以及七种循环迭代策略，包括用于变压器隐式近似的 ODE 的众所周知的数值积分方法。, fully specified, with block and layer iteration modes and seven loop-iteration strategies, comprising of well-known numerical integration methods for an ODE that transformers implicitly approximate.

    跨架构验证Cross-architecture validation在单个模型下的 7 个模型系列和 45 个（模型、基准）单元上on 7 model families and 45 (model, benchmark) cells under a single开箱即用的食谱out-of-the-box recipe (KK-第 4 层的龙格-库塔阶段；用于密集的块模式和用于 MoE 的层模式）-stage Runge–Kutta at the mid 4 layers; block-mode for dense and layer-mode for MoE) with没有任何类型的每单元超参数调整no per-cell hyperparameter tuning of any kind.

  3. 3.

    MoE 的层模式迭代Layer-mode iteration for MoE: LbK∘⋯∘LaKL_{b}^{K}\circ\cdots\circ L_{a}^{K}而不是rather than(Lb∘⋯∘La)K(L_{b}\circ\cdots\circ L_{a})^{K}对于混合专家检查点是必要的is necessary for Mixture-of-Experts checkpoints(Csordás et al., 2024; Bae et al., 2025a, b)，其中块模式导致专家路由在迭代之间发生混乱。, where block-mode causes expert routing to thrash between iterations.

2.2 块模式与层模式迭代Block-mode versus layer-mode iteration

给定窗口运算符Given the window operatorg=Lb∘⋯∘Lag=L_{b}\circ\cdots\circ L_{a}在（in (1），有两种自然实现), there are two natural realizations ofg(K)g^{(K)},

换句话说，块模式将整个窗口作为一个单元进行迭代，而层模式则在传递到下一层之前迭代每一层（图In other words, block-mode iterates the entire window as one unit, whereas layer-mode iterates each layer before passing to the next (Figure1）。对于密集模型). For dense models(Bae et al., 2025a, b)，两者的质量大致相似。对于专家混合 (MoE) 层, the two yield broadly similar quality. For mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers(DeepSeek-AI, 2024; Liu et al., 2025; Csordás et al., 2024)然而，块模式变得不稳定，因为在迭代时, however, block-mode becomes unstable, since at iterationii窗口中每个 MoE 层的门控网络都会看到稍微受到干扰的隐藏状态，并路由到与迭代时不同的专家子集the gating network of every MoE layer in the window sees a slightly perturbed hidden state and routes to a different subset of experts than at iterationi−1i-1，累积的路由引起的噪声最终会压倒预期的改进。另一方面，层模式迭代计算一次门控决策并应用相同的专家混合, and the accumulated routing-induced noise eventually overpowers the intended refinement. On the other hand, layer-mode iteration computes the gating decision once and applies the same expert mixtureKK次times(Csordás et al., 2024)，避免这种故障模式并使其成为 MoE 主干网的正确默认模式。, avoiding this failure mode and making it the correct default for MoE backbones.

These methods are often designed to address specific properties of the underlying dynamics, and we list several prominent examples in Table1。这些算法在顺序、加速器和步长选择上有所不同，将构成我们评估的七种策略的基础。. These algorithms, which differ in order, accelerator, and step size choices, will form the basis for seven strategies that we evaluate.

3 实验Experiments

本节使用没有每个单元超参数调整的固定配方，评估跨密集和 MoE 检查点、基础和指令调整变体以及标准 MHA 和 MLA 主干的免训练循环包装器（This section evaluates the proposed training-free loop wrapper across dense and MoE checkpoints, base and instruction-tuned variants, and both standard MHA and MLA backbones, using a fixed recipe with no per-cell hyperparameter tuning (Section˜3.1)，除非另有说明。), unless otherwise stated.

主要发现。Main findings.

我们的方法在知识密集型多项选择任务上产生了最大和最可靠的收益，特别是 MMLU-Pro、GPQA-Main 和 ARC-Challenge（Our method yields the largest and most reliable gains on knowledge-heavy multiple-choice tasks, especially MMLU-Pro, GPQA-Main, and ARC-Challenge (Section˜3.4）。在各种架构中，大多数单元都是积极的或中性的，失败集中在一些知识 MC 任务的小型蒸馏检查点中（). Across architectures, most cells are positive or neutral, with failures concentrated in small distilled checkpoints on some knowledge-MC tasks (Section˜3.5).

稳健性。Robustness.

有效循环窗口遵循稳定的深度分数规则，而 MoE 模型需要层模式迭代以避免路由抖动（The effective loop window follows a stable depth-fraction rule, while MoE models require layer-mode iteration to avoid routing thrash (Section˜3.2, Table˜2）。大量消融研究证实了循环策略、循环计数、窗口放置、缓存处理和解码设置的鲁棒性（). Numerous ablation studies confirm robustness to loop strategy, loop count, window placement, cache handling, and decoding settings (Section˜3.6).

比较和转移。Comparisons and transfer.

与朴素的推理时间循环变压器相比，我们的方法避免了崩溃，并且在测试单元中表现最佳（Compared with naive inference-time looped transformers, our method avoids collapse and performs best across tested cells (Section˜3.7, Figure˜5）。到 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct 的无泄漏传输进一步支持跨架构泛化（). A leakage-free transfer to Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct further supports cross-architecture generalization (Table˜4).

3.2 深度分数规则The depth fraction rule

在所有八个测试的架构中，最佳窗口的中心位于分数深度的窄带中（表Across all eight tested architectures, the optimal window’s center sits in a narrow band of fractional depth (Table2，并在图中展示了九种架构, and visualized across nine architectures in Figure6附录of AppendixQ）。对于大于 1.7B 的模型，最佳值位于上半部分（0.43–0.71，模式). For models larger than 1.7B, the optimum lies in the upper half (0.43–0.71, mode≈\approx0.50）；对于 sub-1B 型号，它会提前移动 (0.25–0.56)。我们假设头部专门化集中在后面的层，循环必须避免这种情况0.50); for sub-1B models, it shifts earlier (0.25–0.56). We hypothesize that head specialization concentrates in late layers, which the loop must avoid(Belrose et al., 2023; Lad et al., 2024; Men et al., 2025);在小型或重度蒸馏模型中，后层部分较大，因此安全窗口较早开始; in small or heavily distilled models, the late-layer fraction is larger, so the safe window starts earlier(Takase and Kiyono, 2023; Reid et al., 2021).

3.3 MoE 的层模式Layer-mode for MoE

在教育部骨干上On MoE backbones(DeepSeek-AI, 2024; Liu et al., 2025)，默认块模式迭代原因, default block-mode iteration causes路由冲击routing thrash，其中每个块迭代重新评估轻微扰动状态上的门函数，累积路由引起的而不是表示引起的变化。这可以通过切换到层模式迭代来解决，如第 1 节中所述, in which each block iteration re-evaluates the gating function on slightly perturbed states, accumulating routing-induced rather than representation-induced changes. This can be fixed by switching to layer-mode iteration, as discussed in Section2.2和andCsordás et al. (2024); Bae et al. (2025a)。表. Table2比较了 Qwen1.5-MoE 和 Moonlight 上的两种模式，可以看出层模式将大多数负电单元翻转为正电，在硬 MoE 基准测试中产生 +0.5 至 +1.7 pp。compares the two modes on Qwen1.5-MoE and Moonlight, and layer-mode can be seen to flip most negative cells positive, yielding +0.5 to +1.7 pp on hard MoE benchmarks.

4 相关工作Related work

循环和循环深度变压器。Looped and recurrent-depth transformers.

大量工作将递归融入到变压器中A large body of work incorporates recurrence into the transformer at培训training时间，来自重量捆绑的堆栈time, from weight-tied stacks(Dehghani et al., 2019; Lan et al., 2020)和循环表达结果and looped expressivity results(Giannou et al., 2023; Xu and Sato, 2025a; Merrill and Sabharwal, 2025; Gong et al., 2025; Yang et al., 2024; Geiping et al., 2025b)长度概括研究to length-generalization studies(Fan et al., 2025; de Luca and Fountoulakis, 2024; Schwarzschild et al., 2021; Bansal et al., 2022)以及大规模的循环预训练and looped pretraining at scale(Geiping et al., 2025a; Zhu et al., 2025; Prairie et al., 2026; Tang et al., 2026; Wu et al., 2025)。自适应递归变体. Adaptive-recursion variants(Gao et al., 2025; Csordás et al., 2024; Bae et al., 2025b, a; Nouriborji et al., 2025)和隐式深度固定点and implicit-depth fixed points(Bai et al., 2019, 2020)同样将递归与训练联系起来，最近的弹性深度潜在推理模型也是如此likewise tie recurrence to training, as do recent elastic-depth latent reasoning models(Jeddi et al., 2026; Oncescu et al., 2026; Chen, 2026; Knupp et al., 2026; Yu et al., 2026a; Pappone et al., 2025; Koishekenov et al., 2025)。我们的包装器的目标是. Our wrapper instead targets未修改的已发布检查点unmodified released checkpoints (Team, 2025b, 2024a; DeepSeek-AI, 2024; Liu et al., 2025)没有经过任何培训with no training(Liang et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2024; Liang et al., 2026; Nguyen et al., 2025; Chen, 2025; Chen et al., 2026b; Nguyen et al., 2026)，没有辅助损失，也没有架构变化。, no auxiliary loss, and no architectural changes.

推理时间计算和潜在推理。Inference-time compute and latent reasoning.

单独的轴将测试时间计算花费在较长的轨迹上，例如思路链A separate axis spends test-time compute on longer trajectories, e.g. chain-of-thought(Wei et al., 2022; Mohtashami et al., 2025),自洽性, self-consistency(Wang et al., 2023)，以及经过推理训练的 LM, and reasoning-trained LMs(DeepSeek-AI, 2025)，全部保持每个代币的前向不变；理论描述了他们的优势, all leaving the per-token forward unchanged; theory characterizes their advantages(Feng et al., 2023; Merrill and Sabharwal, 2024; Xu and Sato, 2025b; Saunshi et al., 2025)。相反，潜在推理线将计算推入连续空间. Latent-reasoning lines instead push compute into a continuous space(Hao et al., 2024; Cheng and Durme, 2024; Pfau et al., 2024; Goyal et al., 2024; Zeng et al., 2025; Yu et al., 2026b; Geiping et al., 2025a; Li et al., 2026)或者使用自适应停止来“思考”or use adaptive halting to “ponder”(Graves, 2016; Banino et al., 2021; Kohli et al., 2026; Lu et al., 2025; Liang and Pan, 2026; Chen et al., 2026a)，呼应前向计算作为迭代细化的调谐镜头视图, echoing the tuned-lens view of forward computation as iterative refinement(Belrose et al., 2023)和层冗余发现and layer-redundancy findings(Men et al., 2025; Lad et al., 2024; Takase and Kiyono, 2023; Reid et al., 2021)。我们的干预是正交的，因为我们使用更多的计算. Our intervention is orthogonal, as we use more compute一次前向传递中的每个令牌per token within a single forward pass在冻结的检查站上。on a frozen checkpoint.

数值分析方法。Numerical analysis methods.

将残差块视为前向欧拉步骤会激发我们的包装器在循环窗口上公开的一系列积分策略，与定点图一致Treating a residual block as a forward Euler step motivates the family of integration strategies our wrapper exposes on the looped window, in line with the fixed-point picture(Bai et al., 2019, 2020)。在该系列中，我们通过安德森对皮卡德加速进行基准测试. Within that family we benchmark Picard acceleration via Anderson(Walker and Ni, 2011), 重球, heavy-ball(Polyak, 1964; Chen et al., 2024, 2026c; Peng et al., 2026; Liao et al., 2026; Su et al., 2026)、Aitken 外推法和高阶 Runge-Kutta 求解器，但没有找到稳健的节拍, Aitken extrapolation, and higher-order Runge–Kutta solvers, and find none robustly beatsKK-stage Runge-Kutta，表明预训练变压器的环形中间-stage Runge–Kutta, suggesting the looped middle of a pretrained transformer(Giannou et al., 2023; Saunshi et al., 2025; Bae et al., 2025b)在任何有用的意义上都不是收缩的is not contractive in any useful sense(Bai et al., 2019; Belrose et al., 2023)。并发免训练方向通过跳层控制深度. Concurrent training-free directions manipulate depth via layer skipping(Men et al., 2025; Lad et al., 2024)，但据我们所知，没有任何现有方法将中块循环和层模式迭代结合起来进行 MoE 路由, but to our knowledge, no prior method combines mid-block looping and layer-mode iteration for MoE routing(Chen et al., 2026d)跨越现代检查站across modern checkpoints(Team, 2025b, 2024a; DeepSeek-AI, 2024; Liu et al., 2025).

5 结论Conclusion

我们的免训练包装器适用于冻结发布的检查点（Qwen3、Llama-3.2、DeepSeek-V2-Lite、Moonlight、Qwen1.5-MoE），方法是将每个预范数变换器块重新解释为前向欧拉步骤Our training-free wrapper applies to frozen released checkpoints (Qwen3, Llama-3.2, DeepSeek-V2-Lite, Moonlight, Qwen1.5-MoE) by reinterpreting each pre-norm transformer block as a forward Euler step ath=1h{=}1并通过迭代连续的循环窗口提供更好的近似and providing a better approximation via iterating a contiguous loop windowKK次。块模式和层模式迭代均受支持，MoE 主干上需要层模式来稳定每层路由。通用深度分数规则将最佳窗口置于分数深度处times. Block-mode and layer-mode iteration are both supported, with layer-mode required on MoE backbones to stabilize per-layer routing. A universal depth-fraction rule places the optimal window at fractional depth≈\approx16 至 48 层的密集和 MoE 架构为 0.45–0.60。收益集中于知识密集型多项选择基准（MMLU-Pro0.45–0.60 across dense and MoE architectures from 16 to 48 layers. Gains concentrate on knowledge-heavy multiple-choice benchmarks (MMLU-Pro(Wang et al., 2024), GPQA-主要, GPQA-Main(Rein et al., 2024), ARC-挑战, ARC-Challenge(Clark et al., 2018)），其中我们的方法大约增加了 +2 pp，并且在没有每个单元超参数调整的固定开箱即用配方下，七个模型系列和我们的基准套件中 87% 的单元都是非负的。), where our method adds roughly +2 pp, and 87% of cells across seven model families and our benchmark suite are non-negative under the fixed out-of-the-box recipe with no per-cell hyperparameter tuning.

我们修补到冻结模型中的循环前向传递有两种机制，它们共享大部分代码，但循环体与 KV 缓存交互的方式有所不同。期间The looped forward pass we patch into a frozen model has two regimes that share most code but differ in how the loop body interacts with the KV cache. During预填充prefill (seq_len > 1，没有过去的 KV）循环体运行, no past KV) the loop body is run withuse_cache=False并且不向缓存写入任何内容；只有一个and writes nothing to the cache; only a single藏匿通行证stash pass在循环写入规范 KV 之后。期间after the loop writes the canonical KV. During解码decode (seq_len == 1，一个现有的过去的 KV）循环体必须关注过去的 KV；否则，将根据截断的上下文计算新标记。然而，它也必须不产生净 KV 写入，因为存储通道随后将写入规范条目。该机制是在每次循环迭代之前对每个循环层的缓存长度进行快照，并在之后立即裁剪回这些长度。, an existing past KV) the loop body must attend to the past KV; otherwise, the new token is computed against a truncated context. However, it must also produce no net KV writes, since the stash pass will write the canonical entry afterwards. The mechanism is to snapshot per-loop-layer cache lengths before each loop iteration and crop back to those lengths immediately after.

C.2 快照/恢复Snapshot/restore

Transformers.DynamicCache.update()transformers.DynamicCache.update()无条件附加新的unconditionally appends the new(k,v)(k,v)到它的每层张量：没有就地覆盖模式。一个天真的to its per-layer tensor: there is no in-place overwrite mode. A naiveKK-迭代解码体因此会写入-iteration decode body would therefore writeKK每个循环层在同一逻辑解码位置有额外的 KV 条目，然后在下一个解码步骤中处理所有这些条目，从而破坏缓存并生成一系列幻像前缀令牌。快照/恢复模式是最便宜的修复方法，它 (a) 让每个循环迭代处理真实的过去 KV，并且 (b) 让缓存与迭代前完全相同。然后，单个规范 KV 由所选的存储通道写入extra KV entries per loop layer at the same logical decode position, then attend to all of them on the next decode step, corrupting the cache and producing a sequence of phantom prefix tokens. The snapshot/restore pattern is the cheapest fix that (a) lets each loop iteration attend to the genuine past KV and (b) leaves the cache exactly as it was pre-iteration. The single canonical KV is then written by the stash pass on the chosen缓存策略cache_strategy. 层模式layer-mode循环使用类似的每层快照/裁剪对，应用looping uses an analogous per-layer snapshot/crop pair, appliedKK多次移动到一层，然后再继续。times to one layer before moving on.

This is the empirical basis for the claim that环形变压器块不是收缩映射the looped transformer block is not a contractive map，所以定点加速是错误的工具。, so fixed-point acceleration is the wrong tool.

G.4 高阶 ODE 求解器全部降级Higher-order ODE solvers all degrade

在块模式和层模式中，Heun、中点和 RK4 都输给了阻尼欧拉。块模式损耗为 -0.7 至 -1.1 pp；层模式损失为 -1.7 至 -2.3 pp。高阶方法假设基础矢量场是平滑的并且迭代近似 ODE 流；循环块在实践中并不能满足这一点。In both block-mode and layer-mode, Heun, midpoint, and RK4 lose to damped Euler. Block-mode losses are -0.7 to -1.1 pp; layer-mode losses are -1.7 to -2.3 pp. Higher-order methods assume the underlying vector field is smooth and the iteration is approximating an ODE flow; the looped block does not satisfy this in practice.
